content: Semantics of an external trigger event communication The underlying semantics of an external trigger event communication is that a trigger source may initiate the execution of RunnableEntity s in the connected trigger sinks. Typ- ically, (but not necessarily) these RunnableEntity s are executed in a sequential order.
